还要看有多少次需要纠正目的地，以及“已送达”是否经得起核对。: Also check how often destinations need correcting and whether a “delivered” status can be verified.

所有会话、材料、连接状态和回执都是虚构样例；不会向 Codex 或其他工具发送数: All sessions, materials, connection states, and receipts are fictional examples. Nothing is sent to Codex or other tools. “Receipt confirmed” means the handoff completed in this demo; it does not mean an agent understood, executed, or finished the work.
Beamhop 仓库已经包含采集、来源预览、外部投递与恢复路径。当前部分投递方式: The Beamhop repository already includes capture, source previews, external delivery, and recovery paths. Some current delivery methods activate the target app, or only fill its input field and still require submission. The proposals here—addressing a specific session, leaving the foreground unchanged, and confirming receipt—require receiving-tool support. MCP alone does not make them available. Direct-send shortcuts should also establish reliable delivery before reducing the steps.
